Production kernel must support 'always-on' last-trace capture for field crash analysis. Constraints: ETR overhead < 1% CPU, no impact on perf tools, trace ring buffer must survive a kernel panic.

Design a CoreSight always-on trace pipeline:
  1. ETM4 with sparse instruction filtering (TRCSSCCRn)
  2. ETR scatter-gather to a reserved DMA pool
  3. pstore integration so trace is preserved across reboot
  4. Recovery path: read trace from /sys/fs/pstore on next boot
What kernel command-line options enable this, and what is the upstream status (Linux 6.x) of pstore-coresight integration?
